name: @sebastienelet/pr-consolidate
description: Repository-aware pull request consolidation with project-native checks and individual reviews.

scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run build && cargo test --locked --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --features test-fixtures -- --test-threads=3
